title: An Empirically Tractable Dynamic Oligopoly Model: Application to Store Entry and Exit in Dutch Grocery Retail
eligible_reason: Structural dynamic oligopoly model of store entry/exit estimated by maximum likelihood (Bellman/logit); policy experiments. No treatment adoption, no DiD.
design_notes: main.m loads sample_data.mat, dataclean.m builds market-level entry/exit matrices, bellmanlogit.m and likelihoodlogit.m estimate the primitives; experiment.m runs counterfactuals. Regression inventory empty because all code is MATLAB.
data_files_note: Readme.pdf: 'I provide a random sample of 100 markets out of the compiled dataset' (REACH store records, CBS population).
data_provenance_note: Random sample of 100 markets from the full market panel.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract from data/frame/mksc.jsonl is one sentence. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
